net_probe.description: Fetch a URL from the ENGINE process and return the first 40 characters. The first pipe: an MCP tool call, no CSP declaration involved, so it is the control for every browser-side probe beside it.

settings.label: Host key
settings.description: Which host this copy is running in, spelled as one of host-matrix.json's platform_keys. The probe remembers your pick so every row it writes is already labelled.

settings.label: Loopback origin
settings.description: Origin of this engine's own browser viewer, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. Empty means derive it from oma.viewBase.
